tone.voice: an experienced agent who is on your side — informed, honest, never pushy

trust_signals: years of experience and sales history
ux_norms: map view is a primary navigation mode
large property photography drives all decisions
filter and search are always prominent
save / shortlist property is a primary action
virtual tour integration expected at scale
mortgage calculator accessible from property detail
agent contact is always one tap away
floor plan view expected on property detail

photography_rules: always use high quality property photography
exterior shots with clear sky preferred
never use renders as primary imagery without labelling
visual_language.background_treatment: clean white or light grey — never compete with property imagery
visual_language.empty_state_style: minimal line illustration — house outline or map pin with helpful copy
visual_language.onboarding_visual: clean flat vector — house, key, or map theme
visual_language.illustration_style: when used: architectural line illustration — precise and professional

compliance_notes: fair housing and anti-discrimination laws apply
property data accuracy and currency must be maintained
financial advice disclaimer for mortgage calculators
GDPR for buyer and seller data
